letter_deductions.deduction: Claim not admissible: The claim is for treatment of a knee joint condition. Diseases of the joints are listed illnesses with a 24-month waiting period. Your policy started on 01-Feb-2026, so the waiting period has not been completed and the claim is not admissible.
letter_deductions.why: Waiting period counted from the current renewal instead of first inception.
